''' Roberto Gargini ''' (born 30 April 1962 in [[Trelew]]) is a former [[Argentina|Argentine]] professional [[football (soccer)]] player.

==Club career==
Gargini played for [[Ferro Carril Oeste]] and [[Club Atlético Chaco For Ever|Chaco For Ever]] in the [[Primera División de Argentina]].<ref>{{cite web|publisher=BDFA|title=Ficha del Roberto Gargini|url=http://www.bdfa.com.ar/jugador.asp?codigo=9247|accessdate=2009-02-09}}</ref> He had also had a spell with [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]] in the [[Super League Greece]] during the 1990–91 season.<ref>{{cite web|title=Foreign Players in Greece since 1959/60|website=[[RSSSF]]|url=https://www.rsssf.org/players/foreign-players-in-grk6080.html|accessdate=2009-02-09}}</ref>
